effectivecaveculling.config.title: Effective Cave Culling
effectivecaveculling.config.enabled.desc: Master switch for sealing unreachable caves. Applies immediately, including while you are in a world.
effectivecaveculling.config.whitelist.de: The mod runs only in listed worlds, so it stays off everywhere until you add one. Singleplayer keys look like world/"New World". Server keys are the address, without a port on the default Minecraft port, and host:port otherwise.
Adds the world or server you are currently in when it is not already in the whitelist.
